t: The LAP Twiny outdoor LED solar-powered floodlight delivers reliable, automatic security lighting without the need for mains wiring. This wall-mounted fixture is ideal for illuminating dark driveways, domestic gardens and pathways. Featuring dual adjustable heads, the unit projects a bright 800 lumen daylight glow exactly where needed. An integrated PIR motion sensor detects movement up to 8m away within a 90° range, while the pre-set dusk-to-dawn sensor ensures efficient operation. Built with a durable plastic body and diffuser, this IP44-rated weatherproof light offers up to 15,000 hours of life.
b: Integrated PIR Motion Sensor Detects Movement Automatically
